resources.string: Count how many phones run each ZeroS build

When this is on, the phone sends ZeroS one short report a day. It holds an ID made from the phone\'s Android ID with a one-way hash, the phone model, the build version, a country code and the mobile network\'s name. It does not include your name, phone number, accounts, location or files. ZeroS uses the reports only to count how many phones run each build, and deletes each one after 13 months.\n\nTap Preview data to see exactly what is sent.
Once a day, send ZeroS the data shown in Preview data
